description: List upcoming Australian (default) or New Zealand races, thoroughbred, harness and greyhound, grouped by meeting, with start times (local and UTC), distance, class and each race's race ID for race_odds, race_form and race_result. Needs a paid plan or the free Pro trial; the list itself costs no credits.

meeting.description: Only meetings whose track name contains this, for example Randwick
